description: A Claude Code plugin cannot ship a `statusLine`, so `ovld agent-setup claude --status-line` writes one to the user's settings.json. It is opt-in, never replaces an existing status line (the user gets a hint to pipe the same stdin into `ovld status-line` from their own script) and leaves an unreadable settings file untouched. The command reads the status-line JSON on stdin and refreshes every 10 s so an answer or a new question shows while the session is idle.
